messages:
olivia (docs): starting a quick PR to update docs for the quota header change in SDK v2 + add migration snippets (curl, go, py). will also add a small dashboard link and FAQ entry.
mike (eng-api): thanks — can you call out the header rename? backend now returns `X-RW-Quota-Remaining` instead of `X-Quota-Remaining`. small change but lots of customers hit it.
olivia (docs): yep planning a short section: old header -> new header mapping + example code to read both (fallback).
harpreet (eng-plat): also note that when requests are proxied through the gateway we sometimes add `X-Region` which affects quota attribution. worth a line.
mike (eng-api): good call. and include example showing handling 429 with `Retry-After` parsing. we added millisecond support last month.
rachael (product): can we surface where in the console the quota panel moved? PMs keep getting asked where to find per-route quota. a direct link to the new panel would help.
olivia (docs): will add screenshot of the console panel and the anchor link to the new route usage table. saml tenants may see a different path — will mention that.
jules (support): also add a tiny troubleshooting FAQ: "why my app shows higher usage than dashboard" (answers: delayed ingestion, rounding of token->unit conversions). i've seen multiple tickets about that.
olivia (docs): good bug sense. will add an explanation of rounding and an example calculation.
tom (eng-sre): one more note: the rate limiter adds a soft-warning webhook at 85% of quota for Dedicated tenants. maybe include a line about monitoring and webhook docs.
olivia (docs): adding a short section: alerting hooks + example payload (headers + body).
mike (eng-api): for snippets, show Go http client example reading headers, plus node/py. keep them minimal.
olivia (docs): plan: curl (one-liner), Go (net/http), Python (requests). will include a tiny helper for parsing `Retry-After` that handles int seconds and RFC-1123 dates.
rachael (product): thumbs up. also cross-link to pricing tiers page and clarify which tiers get burst credits vs committed rates.
olivia (docs): will paste the canonical tier table rows (internal doc) and mark them as referenced.
jules (support): propose adding a short "What changed for existing customers" callout at the top of the guide. prevents churn from surprise headers.
olivia (docs): good idea 12 will add a bold callout.
docs-bot: A PR has been opened by olivia in docs repo: PR #1202 60 "quota-header-migration-and-snippets" :github:
mike (eng-api): can you also include a tiny unit test snippet showing how to assert header parsing? saves back-and-forth during reviews.
olivia (docs): added a test example in /snippets/tests/header_parsing_test.go
harpreet (eng-plat): note for reviewers: quota attribution change also updated logs. include the log key `quota_bucket` in the example so customers searching logs can map traffic.
olivia (docs): done. added a short log-mapping table.
deploy-bot: staging preview for PR #1202 is available at https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/1202 (expires in 7 days)
rachael (product): can we grab the staging screenshot from that preview? use the /console/usage route. PMs will train from that.
olivia (docs): grabbing screenshot and will compress for docs size limits.
jules (support): small copy suggestion: change "quota header" -> "quota response headers" in the H2, sounded clearer.
olivia (docs): updated heading and microcopy. pushed a commit.
docs-bot: PR #1202 updated (2 commits) 60 reviewers: mike, harpreet.
mike (eng-api): quick review done. left 3 tiny inline nits (code formatting). not blocking.
harpreet (eng-plat): looks good to me. one prod note: if a customer uses our edge proxy the header key might be lowercased; suggest code samples use case-insensitive lookup.
olivia (docs): added a short code comment in each snippet about case-insensitive header access.
docs-bot: PR #1202 merged by olivia (docs) 60 commit b3c9f4a 60 "docs: quota header migration guide + snippets + console link"
olivia (docs): merged. i'll open a tiny follow-up to add the support ticket template for quota header regressions.
rachael (product): perfect, thanks everyone.
mike (eng-api): nice work. :shipit: 
olivia (docs): closing this thread, will notify #support when follow-up ticket template PR is ready.
